## *** CLAUDEFORCE — announced 2026-08-26, alongside Q2 FY27 earnings. NEW. ***

### 1. "Salesforce in Claude" — a PLUGIN that runs INSIDE Claude
   - 37 PREBUILT SALES SKILLS, described as engineered for Claude rather than generic
     API wrapping. Named examples: meeting prep, deal health review, pipeline review.
   - Lets sellers "reason over LIVE REVENUE CONTEXT, automate pipeline updates, and take
     GOVERNED ACTION right from Claude."
   - Availability: select PILOT customers now; OPEN BETA expected SEPTEMBER 2026.
   - "Additional prebuilt skills will begin launching in late 2026."
   => DIRECTION OF FLOW IS INVERTED vs everything previously reported for this platform.
      Historically Salesforce hosted the agent. Here the agent host is CLAUDE and
      Salesforce is the tool/data surface reached from outside the CRM.
   NOTE: claude.com/plugins/sales is a DIFFERENT, generic Sales plugin (4 commands:
   /call-summary, /forecast, /pipeline-review + 5 auto skills, CRM-agnostic via MCP).
   Do not conflate the two. No public docs page for the 37-skill Salesforce plugin yet.

### 2. Claude INSIDE Agentforce — now the default model in several components
   - Powers the ATLAS REASONING ENGINE
   - DEFAULT model for AGENTFORCE VIBES
   - DEFAULT model for AGENTFORCE COWORKER
   - Available in AGENT BUILDER
   *** AGENTFORCE COWORKER HAS NEVER BEEN REPORTED BY THIS MONITOR (grep: 0 hits). ***
   Coworker = an AI teammate surfaced "in every search bar" across the Salesforce
   experience; announced ~May 2026, provisions automatically through Salesforce
   Foundation Flex Credits; unmetered for Agentforce 1 Edition / Agentforce for Sales,
   Service, Industries licences PROVIDED user-based AI permissions are configured —
   otherwise the same users consume credits. (Corroborated via secondary sources only;
   Salesforce Help is unreachable.)

### 3. Claude in SLACK
   - "the intelligent backbone across every layer of the Slack experience"
   - Powers SLACKBOT; augments team decision-making via CLAUDE TAG; founding partner
     for SLACK CODE.
   (Claude Tag was reported 2026-07-03 as an agentic Slack teammate with admin-scoped
   identities and tool/data/codebase access. This makes it a first-class Slack layer.)

### 4. Deployment / trust boundary
   - Delivered THROUGH AMAZON BEDROCK, "within the Salesforce Trust Boundary."
   - Prior partnership material states Anthropic is "the first LLM provider fully
     integrated within the Salesforce trust boundary, with all of Claude's traffic
     contained within the Salesforce virtual private cloud."
   => the Claude traffic is inside Salesforce's VPC via Bedrock; neither a Salesforce-only
      nor an Anthropic-only control plane sees the whole path.
